attchmntText: SKIL Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about reasons for Delayed/Non-submission of Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026,
desc: Reasons for Delayed/Non-submission of Financial Results
voiceSummary: SKIL Infrastructure Limited informs the NSE and BSE of the non-submission of financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The company is under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process since February 1, 2024. Purusottam Behera serves as Resolution Professional. Delays resulted from non-cooperation by the Company Secretary and statutory auditors. The auditors initially refused to finalize accounts for the quarter ended September 30, 2024, due to outstanding dues. They later agreed to cooperate in October 2025. The company has submitted results up to December 31, 2025. It is currently compiling pending results for subsequent periods. The Resolution Professional requests regulatory relaxation for the delayed submissions.

attchmntText: SKIL Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Outcome of the Fifteenth (15th) Committee of Creditors meeting held on Wednesday, November 11,  2026
voiceSummary: SKIL Infrastructure Limited informs the National Stock Exchange and BSE that its Fifteenth Committee of Creditors meeting was postponed from November 09, 2026, to November 11, 2026. The meeting concluded on November 11, 2026, at 01:45 P.M. The announcement references prior disclosures dated November 06, 2026, and November 09, 2026. Purusottam Behera, the Resolution Professional, submitted this update pursuant to SEBI Listing Regulations. No specific resolutions or voting outcomes are detailed in this text. The company is under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process as per the NCLT Mumbai order dated February 01, 2024.

attchmntText: SKIL Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the postponement of the Fifteenth (15th) Committee of Creditors meeting to be held on Monday, November 09, 2026
voiceSummary: SKIL Infrastructure Limited intimates the postponement of its Fifteenth Committee of Creditors meeting. The meeting originally scheduled for Monday, November 09, 2026, at 12:30 P.M. in virtual mode is rescheduled to Thursday, November 11, 2026, at 12:30 P.M. The Resolution Professional is Purusottam Behera. The company is under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process with the Hon’ble NCLT, Mumbai, per an order dated 1st February 2024. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 and Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The previous disclosure regarding this matter was dated November 06, 2026.
